name: cloudzone-hava
description: Full Hava.io API access: list, search, export and manage cloud architecture diagrams for AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes.

api_token.title: Hava API token
api_token.description: Required. From app.hava.io -> your avatar -> Personal Settings -> API Tokens -> Display Token. Stored in your OS secure storage, not in settings.json. Needs a Hava Teams/Business plan or self-hosted install.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes anything in Hava, leaving 19 read-only tools. Recommended unless you need to create, export or administer.
